title: 第930章 超脱者大战第929章 混沌龙主降临
lines: 看到是混沌龙主出现了，暗九天邪却是不惊反喜。
他负手立在虚空之中，周身翻滚的不祥黑潮如活物般起伏，枯槁的脸上扯出一抹冰冷的笑意，淡淡道：
“呵呵，混沌龙主，上一次你我之间的大战没有结束，你今日又迫不及待地前来送死了？”
原来，之前在无归界现身阻挡混沌龙主、使其无法驰援叶无缺的那个不祥超脱者，正是这个暗九天邪！
当日两人激战数千回合，最终以暗九天邪抽身撤退告终，胜负未分。
此刻再度相遇，新仇旧怨涌上，两人眼底皆是杀意翻腾。
混沌龙主傲立虚空，金色龙袍猎猎作响，身后隐隐有万龙咆哮的虚影。
他将整个第二道防线牢牢护在身后，手中帝龙戟斜指大地，戟尖吞吐着数万丈长的金色龙芒，目光淡漠得看着暗九天邪，声如洪钟：
“今日，延续一百多年之前的那一战！”
“也终结你祸乱诸天的罪孽！”
话音未落，一股滔天龙威陡然从帝龙戟里面炸裂开来！
金色的龙威光柱直冲云霄，将头顶厚重的不祥黑云硬生生撕裂出一道巨大的缺口。
光柱之中，无数古老的龙形符文载沉载浮，每一道都蕴含着崩碎星辰、斩断因果的恐怖伟力，足以横扫诸天万界、古今未来！
“大戟横空斩因果，万古凋零神灵默！”
伴随着一声震彻寰宇的怒吼，混沌龙主身形一动，化作一道贯穿天地的金色流光，悍然杀向了暗九天邪！
帝龙戟在他手中怒斩而出，戟身之上缠绕的金龙虚影昂首咆哮，一戟落下，竟是将前方的时空都硬生生劈成了两半！
错乱的时空乱流朝着两侧疯狂翻涌，露出了深处混沌一片的虚无。
戟芒所过之处，一切法则、秩序、因果尽数断裂湮灭，只剩下最纯粹的毁灭与霸道。
“来的好！”
暗九天邪冷笑一声，不闪不避。
他猛地探出右手，五指成爪，浓郁的不祥之力在掌心疯狂汇聚，转瞬间便化作一只覆盖万里的漆黑巨爪。
巨爪之上，密密麻麻的不祥符文蠕动闪烁，散发着腐蚀万物、沉沦众生的邪恶气息。
“暗天邪爪·万灵沉沦！”
金黑两道恐怖的攻击在半空中狠狠碰撞！
刹那间，整片无归时空海都剧烈地颤抖起来！
一圈圈毁灭性的能量冲击波以碰撞点为中心，朝着四面八方疯狂扩散而去。
沿途所过，无数时空碎片被碾成最细微的混沌粒子，数不清的小型残破世界在冲击波中化为飞灰。
下方第二道防线的防御大阵疯狂震颤，阵纹之上裂开密密麻麻的缝隙，无数镇守大阵的修士口喷鲜血倒飞而出。
若非大阵本身便建在时空节点之上，又有无数修士倾力维持，仅仅这一击的余波，便足以让整道防线灰飞烟灭。
劫后余生的神秘生灵、妙妙仙子等人全都长长松了一口气，后背早已被冷汗浸透。
刚才暗九天邪的这一击若是真的彻底落下，他们所有人，都必定必死无疑！
没有任何生还的可能。
第二道防线也将彻底瞬间崩塌，无尽的不祥大军将在暗九天邪的带领下，从无归路长驱直入，杀向诸天万界！
到那时，便是真正的末日降临。
“这是……混沌龙主！是混沌龙主大人救了我们，拯救了第二防线！”
有人盯着天空中那道纵横捭阖的金色身影，声音颤抖着惊呼出声。
渐渐地，越来越多的人看清了那道和暗九天邪大战的、盖世龙威弥漫、无限霸道的伟岸身影。
顿时，第二防线所有生灵，全都露出了无限的敬畏和激动之色。
这可是混沌龙主！
一个名震九天十地、扬名诸天万界的亘古传奇！
万古岁月以前，混沌龙主手持大龙戟，征战无归路，一路横推不祥族群，硬生生杀到了大劫的最深处，铸就了无限辉煌的战绩！
他以一己之力，硬生生挡住了当年那一波灭世大劫的主力，为诸天万族争取到了喘息之机，对诸天万界有难以言喻的大功绩、大伟业！
后来，混沌龙主似乎是为了去寻找无归路最深处的终极秘密，一去不回。
content_en:
Seeing that the Chaos Dragon Lord appeared, An Jiutianxie was not surprised but overjoyed.
He stood in the void with his hands folded, the ominous black tide rolling around him rising and falling like a living thing, a cold smile appeared on his withered face, and he said lightly:
"Haha, Chaos Dragon Lord, the last war between you and me didn't end, and you can't wait to come and die again today?"
It turns out that the ominous transcendent person who appeared in the realm of no return to block the Chaos Dragon Lord and prevent him from rushing to Ye Wuque's aid was none other than the Dark Nine Heavenly Evil!
The two fought fiercely for thousands of rounds that day, and finally ended with An Jiutianxie retreating, with no winner or loser.
At this moment, they met again, new and old grudges surged up, and murderous intent surged in their eyes.
The Chaos Dragon Lord stood proudly in the void, his golden dragon robe making a hunting sound, and behind him there were faint shadows of roaring dragons.
He firmly protected the entire second line of defense behind him. He pointed the Emperor Dragon Halberd diagonally at the ground in his hand. The tip of the halberd breathed out tens of thousands of feet of golden dragon light. He looked at An Jiutianxie with indifferent eyes and sounded like a loud bell:
"Today, the battle from more than a hundred years ago continues!"
"This will also put an end to your sins of causing trouble to the heavens!"
“Rumble——!!!”
Before he finished speaking, a monstrous dragon power suddenly exploded from the Emperor Dragon Halberd!
The golden dragon's mighty light pillar shot straight into the sky, tearing a huge gap into the thick ominous black cloud above his head.
In the pillar of light, countless ancient dragon-shaped runes are floating and sinking. Each one contains the terrifying power of shattering stars and cutting off cause and effect, which is enough to sweep across the heavens and worlds, ancient and modern, and the future!
"The great halberd cuts the cause and effect across the sky, and the gods wither and remain silent for eternity!"
Accompanied by a roar that shook the world, the Chaos Dragon Lord moved and turned into a golden stream of light that penetrated the heaven and earth, and killed An Jiutian Xie brazenly!
The Emperor Dragon Halberd was slashed out in his hand. The shadow of the golden dragon wrapped around the halberd raised its head and roared. When the halberd fell, it actually split the time and space in front of it in half!
The chaotic flow of time and space surged crazily towards both sides, revealing the chaotic nothingness in the depths.
Wherever the halberd light passes, all laws, order, and cause and effect are broken and annihilated, leaving only the purest destruction and domineering.
"Well done!"
An Jiutianxie sneered and refused to dodge.
He suddenly stretched out his right hand, and his five fingers turned into claws. The rich and ominous power gathered crazily in his palm, and in an instant it turned into a huge black claw covering thousands of miles.
On the giant claw, densely packed ominous runes squirm and flicker, exuding an evil aura that corrodes all things and sinks all living beings.
"Dark Sky Evil Claw·All Souls Perish!"
"Bang——!!!"
The two terrifying attacks of gold and black collided fiercely in mid-air!
In an instant, the entire sea of ​​time and space trembled violently!
Circles of destructive energy shock waves centered on the collision point and spread crazily in all directions.
Along the way, countless fragments of time and space were crushed into the tiniest chaotic particles, and countless small broken worlds were turned into ashes in the shock wave.
The defensive formation of the second line of defense below shook crazily, and dense gaps opened up on the formation lines. Countless monks guarding the formation spurted blood and flew out.
If the formation itself was not built on the nodes of time and space, and countless monks worked hard to maintain it, the aftermath of this attack alone would be enough to wipe out the entire defense line.
The mysterious creatures, Fairy Miaomiao and others who survived the disaster all breathed a long sigh of relief, their backs already soaked with cold sweat.
If An Jiutian Xie's blow just now was really completely delivered, all of them would definitely die!
There was no chance of survival.
The second line of defense will completely collapse in an instant, and the endless ominous army, led by An Jiutianxie, will march straight in from the point of no return and kill all the worlds!
At that time, the real doomsday will come.
"This is...Chaos Dragon Lord! It was Chaos Dragon Lord who saved us and the second line of defense!"
Someone stared at the golden figure criss-crossing in the sky, and exclaimed with a trembling voice.
Gradually, more and more people saw clearly the majestic figure filled with unparalleled dragon power and infinite domineering power who fought against An Jiutian Evil.
Suddenly, all the creatures on the second line of defense showed infinite awe and excitement.
This is the Chaos Dragon Lord!
An eternal legend that is famous throughout the world and is famous throughout the world!
Eons ago, the Chaos Dragon Lord held the great dragon halberd and fought with no return. He pushed the ominous tribes all the way and fought his way to the depths of the catastrophe, creating an infinitely glorious record!
With his own power, he blocked the main force of that wave of world-destroying catastrophe, and gained a breathing space for all the races in the world. He made unspeakable great contributions and great deeds to all the worlds!
Later, the Chaos Dragon Lord seemed to be searching for the ultimate secret at the deepest point of no return, never to return.
title_en: Chapter 930 The Battle of the Transcendents Chapter 929 The Arrival of the Chaos Dragon Lord
